facts.text: First-time entering freshmen can enroll in the Guaranteed Tuition Rate Program to lock in their tuition rate for four years to protect against tuition hikes and increases.

sources.title: Payment Options - Business Office
sources.quote: First-time entering freshman may enroll in the Guaranteed Tuition Rate Program locking in their tuition rate for four years. This protects you from tuition hikes and increases and allows you to budget with no surprises.

facts.text: Native American students make up 28% of Southeastern's student population, and the university ranks 7th in the nation for graduating Native students.

sources.title: Native American Institute - Southeastern Oklahoma State University

facts.text: Southeastern Oklahoma State University offers all out-of-state students 100% non-resident tuition waivers.

sources.title: Southeastern holds line on tuition costs for 2022-2023
sources.quote: Southeastern remains of the most affordable universities in Oklahoma and Texas, offering all out-of-state students 100% non-resident tuition waivers.
